notes.title: NetHack: Legacy v1.0.5.1 released, Audio Update II and OST!
notes.content:
This release features even more ambiances and music, further enriching your adventures in the world of NetHack! See the changelog below for the full list of changes.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*] Adds new music tracks to Gnomish Mines and Sokoban
[*] Adds new music tracks and ambiances to endgame levels
[*] Changes title screen
[*] Fixes issue with audio sometimes dropping on screen resize
[/list]

[h1]NetHack: Legacy OST[/h1]
The official soundtrack is now available for your listening pleasure! Explore the Dungeons of Doom without the threat of starvation or vengeful Ants looming over your head! With over an hour of beautifully composed music, you can revisit your favorite areas and tracks, or take a peek into environments you have yet to discover! The full album also includes bonus, loopable ambiance tracks for setting the mood at your next tabletop game session!

[url= https://andreabaroni.bandcamp.com/album/nethack-legacy-original-soundtrack]NetHack: Legacy OST on Bandcamp[/url]

notes.title: NetHack: Legacy v1.0.4.2 released, Audio Update!
notes.content:
This release features more ambiances, music, and special effects to further immerse you into the world of NetHack! See the changelog below for the full list of changes.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*] Adds new ambiances and tracks
[*] Adds sound effects
[*] Adds text search option to replay viewer
[*] Changes "mouse_support" option to allow disabling
[*] Changes replay viewer to play soundtrack
[*] Fixes occasional "PID mismatch" issue
[*] Fixes issue with "unknown details" on some leaderboard entries
[*] Fixes issue with leaderboard replays sometimes disappearing
[*] Fixes issue with replays sometimes being corrupted
[*] Fixes issue with replays sometimes not displaying correctly on jumps
[*] Fixes issues with audio sometimes glitching/not playing in correct areas
[/list]

notes.title: NetHack: Legacy v1.0.3.3 released, introducing Leaderboards!
notes.content:
This release introduces Steam Leaderboards. Available through the "Extras" menu, see how you rank in comparison to your fellow Dungeoneers, and see their adventures with the integrated replay system! See the changelog below for the full list of changes.

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*] Adds Steam Leaderboard integration
[*] Adds 'steam' option to enable/disable Steam services
[*] Fixes issue with potentially incorrect replay metadata
[/list]

notes.title: NetHack: Legacy v1.0.2.1 released!
notes.content:
This release introduces Steam Achievements. See the changelog below for the full list of changes. Happy Hacking! 

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*] Adds Steam Achievements
[*] Fixes bug with some quests not being completable
[*] Fixes main dungeon music looping continuously
[/list]

notes.title: NetHack: Legacy v1.0.1.2 released!
notes.content:
This is a general bug fix patch addressing a few issues found after launch. Notably, the install size is much smaller and also includes the source code (which is also available from the official website). See the changelog below for the full list of changes. Enjoy! 

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*] Adds source code to distribution
[*] Adds support for special/Unicode characters in filepaths on Windows
[*] Adds "movement_keys" option to toggle old "number_pad" bindings
[*] Adds missing credits and other minor corrections to game manual
[*] Adds "#name" extended command as alias for "#call"
[*] Changes audio encoding and various other improvements for smaller install size
[*] Changes "screen_curve" option to 0 by default
[*] Changes "#twoweapon" extended command to autocomplete by default
[*] Fixes broken playback navigation functions
[*] Fixes occasional "Bad fruit" bug
[*] Fixes issue with save files not opening sometimes
[*] Fixes large maps being clipped on interface
[*] Fixes bones not working on Windows
[*] Fixes options not saving initially on Windows
[*] Fixes missing application icon on Windows
[/list]

[h1]Note for macOS users[/h1]
If you have problems launching the game after this update, uninstall and reinstall the game.
